# Ferro Studio

> Ferro Studio is a Polish custom metal-cutting studio. It makes company logos and signage, wall decorations, and fully custom metal pieces to order, shipped nationwide across Poland. Positioning: premium/craft, not price-driven.

## Pages

- [Strona główna](https://ferrostudio.pl/): Studio overview, offer (logotypes, wall pieces, custom work), materials, one project (Society Landscape), contact.
- [Jak zamawiać](https://ferrostudio.pl/jak-zamawiac): Step-by-step ordering process, what to prepare, price/time guidance, FAQ.
- [Wycena](https://ferrostudio.pl/wycena): Short brief form for a project quote.
- [Kontakt](https://ferrostudio.pl/kontakt): Contact form, phone, email, and ordering FAQ.

## Notes

- Site language: Polish only. Service area: all of Poland (nationwide courier shipping), studio based in the Łódź region.
- Legal/company details (name, address, NIP) appear only on the legal pages: /polityka-prywatnosci, /regulamin, /cookies.
- Full sitemap: https://ferrostudio.pl/sitemap-index.xml
